subject: SIG questionnaire initiation and follow-up after discovery call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmebank.com>
Cc: AcmeBank Security Team <security@acmebank.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: security questionnaire / next steps

Hi Laura / Acme Security Team,

Thanks again for taking time on the call today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Recap: we covered integration options (hosted API vs Redwood Dedicated), data residency requirements, and high-level compliance needs (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
- Next step (security): you mentioned preferring that we initiate a SIG-Core questionnaire and share SOC artifacts. Attached is our SIG-Core PDF export and our latest SOC artifact.

Can you confirm:
1) Do you prefer we complete the SIG online portal or send the completed XLS/PDF back to you?
2) Who should be the technical point of contact on your side for follow-up questions (name + email)?
3) Any date constraints to resolve the questionnaire before your procurement review (target date would be helpful)?

I've cc'd Marcus (solutions engineering) and Priyom (sales engineer) to own the SIG responses and provide any technical attachments (pen test summary, key management details, etc.).

Attachments: SIG-Core-Questionnaire.pdf (stub), redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (stub), redwood-security-overview.pdf (stub)

Thanks — we'll aim to get the SIG back within 3-5 business days once we confirm preferred format and owners.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: AcmeBank Security Team <security@acmebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmebank.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: security questionnaire / next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. A few clarifying questions before you start the SIG: 

1) Which deployment(s) are the written answers scoped to (hosted API, Redwood Dedicated, or both)? We need per-environment answers where they differ.
2) SOC coverage: do you have a SOC 2 Type II report available? If not, what is the expected completion date?
3) Do you offer a BAA for HIPAA workloads? If so, which deployment types are covered?
4) Encryption: confirmation of encryption at rest (alg) and KMS options (customer-managed keys/HSM support).
5) Data retention and log access policies for hosted customers (are prompts/inputs persisted by default?).
6) Do you have an external pentest summary or bug bounty report we can review?

We typically prefer a completed SIG XLS but can accept a filled PDF if you have attachments. Our technical reviewer is myself (AcmeBank Security Team, security@acmebank.com) and Laura Jenkins will coordinate procurement. Would appreciate initial responses or an estimate of when we'll have the completed SIG.

Thanks,
AcmeBank Security Team
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-02-20T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: security questionnaire / next steps — action items (SIG answers)

Marcus / Priyom — forwarding questions from AcmeBank security. Can you please: 

- Confirm which deployment modes we should answer for (hosted API + Dedicated).
- Populate the SIG-Core answers (I attached their questionnaire PDF and our SOC/overview docs).
- Provide short pen-test/bug-bounty summary and link to SOC artifact.

Target: can we get a draft back to me by EOD 2026-02-23 PST so I can review and send to Acme in their preferred SIG XLS format? If needs more time, indicate expected date.

Thanks — I can handle procurement-facing language and the delivery.

Best,
Marissa
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeBank Security Team <security@acmebank.com>, Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmebank.com>
Date: 2026-02-21T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: security questionnaire / next steps — action items (SIG answers)

Marissa / team — taking point on the technical responses. Draft answers and links below (will add to SIG XLS/PDF):

- Scope: we will provide per-environment answers for Hosted API and Redwood Dedicated (and note differences).
- SOC: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type I report for 2025 (attached). SOC 2 Type II audit is in-flight with expected completion May 2026; draft readiness report available on request.
- BAA: Yes, Redwood offers a BAA for HIPAA-covered workloads. BAAs are available for Hosted API customers and included by contract for Dedicated/Private deployments where needed.
- Encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit; AES-256 for encryption at rest. Customer-managed keys are supported in Dedicated and Private deployments via KMS/HSM integrations; hosted customers can request CMK options for enterprise plans.
- Data retention: By default, Hosted API does not retain customer prompts beyond request processing for customers who opt-out of retention; we document retention policy in the contract. Dedicated/Private deployments provide full control over retention. Logs and audit trails can be provided for a retention window defined in the SLA.
- Pen test / bug bounty: We have an annual third-party penetration test (summary attached as pen-test-summary.pdf stub) and an internal vulnerability program. We also run a public/managed bug-bounty program; we can provide a redacted summary of findings and remediation timelines.

Attachments to include in SIG package: redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (stub), pen-test-summary.pdf (stub), redwood-security-overview.pdf (stub).

If Acme wants specific artifact links or a short compliance call, happy to join.

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@acmebank.com>

Thanks Marissa and Marcus — this is helpful. A few follow-ups: 

- We'd prefer the completed SIG XLS with artifacts attached (SOC, pen-test summary, BAA template).
- Please mark which answers are specific to Hosted API vs Dedicated.
- We need an estimate for final answers by EOD 2026-02-27 if possible; otherwise let us know a realistic timeline.
- Can Redwood provide a redacted pentest summary and SOC artifact under an NDA? We'll share our standard NDA if needed.

If you can get the SIG over and indicate owner for future Qs (technical and legal), we'll triage and schedule a short compliance review call next week.

Thanks,
Laura Jenkins
